totals.basis: sum of the per-consumer rows above; the W6 column is a projection from the W0 baseline, the W3 column is measured on retained evidence

restore_and_fallback_observations.restore-path-composition: the guarded restore installs the job-local Racket runtime (pinned installer SHA-256), downloads the artifact, verifies the manifest tuple, materializes store + compiled output, runs four read-only health checks; the W6 identity-manifest compare adds sub-second tooling work after the restore
restore_and_fallback_observations.retained-restore-telemetry: artifacts/ci-baseline/v1.00.26-prepared-env/report.json holds the warm-observation window (129 records, all fallback with restore-ms 'unknown' — the window predates activation, so no restore-ms telemetry exists there); the only retained measured restored-path setup numbers are the run-34450964386 test-shard setup steps (23/20/40 s)
restore_and_fallback_observations.fallback-observations: cold fallback remains functional and loud: producer-skipped and restore-mismatch paths route to the full install+compile path with ::warning + REBUILT summary (W3), and the W6 identity compare adds the counted identity-mismatch fallback (::warning + counted record + RUNNER_TEMP stamp) — exercised at the tool level by tests/test-prepared-env-report.rkt (wrong racket digest / wrong OS profile / wrong lock digest all fail closed) and by the save-side identity manifest stamped on every full path
restore_and_fallback_observations.verified_restore_rate_gate: threshold 95 percent; the post-activation observation window reopens with the W5 ci.yml wiring (emit-restore-record) which now also covers the six newly activated consumers via the same setup-racket outputs — the aggregated window report is the evidence vehicle, and this wave records no fabricated rate

honesty.no-fabricated-measurements: every W6-activation row is marked projected-from-w0-baseline with its formula; the only measured rows are the W3-activated test shards, whose retained evidence is cited
honesty.projection-is-an-upper-bound: the projection subtracts only the measured restored-path estimate from the own-lane baseline; unmeasured restore-path overheads (artifact download variance) can only shrink the realized saving
honesty.unknown-values-are-strings: wherever retained telemetry has no number, the value is the string 'unknown', never a fabricated zero
